newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Four killed in Karachi violence.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Karachi violence.

text.p: At least four people were killed in violence in Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi on Wednesday , police said.

They said gunmen entered a house in the Saudabad district and shot dead Mohammad Azhar, a brother of journalist Mohammad Anwar, who worked for the local Jasarat newspaper. Anwar's cousin Mohammad Rauf was also killed in the attack.
In separate incidents, an unidentified body stuffed into a sack was found in the Liaquatabad area and a man was killed by gunfire in Shah Latif Town, police said.
They had no word on the motives for the killings, the latest in a surge of violence in Karachi in recent weeks.
Militants of the Mutahida National Movement, which renamed itself last month from the Mohajir National Movement (MQM), have been feuding with supporters of the breakaway MQM-Haqiqi group.
More than 225 people have died in ethnic, sectarian and political violence in Karachi this year, compared to about 500 last year and more than 2,000 in 1995.
The MQM was brought into a coalition government in Sindh province, of which Karachi is the capital, after national and provincial elections in February.
